notes:
Both full-thesis PDF links returned HTTP 403 and were not retried. Alternative institutional records were abstract-only and linked back to the same thesis repository. Generic abstract sample sizes and narrative claims were not substituted for target-test evidence.
Source follow-up: Complete Spring 2024 master’s thesis, EIU repository 5025. Table 7 rendered PDF p. 69 visually inspected. Table 7 reports paired mean differences, distinct from the Pearson correlations elsewhere. No effect-specific author verdict about replication of this mean-difference test located; no success inferred from p. Table 7 note: “*p < .05 (Bonferroni correction α = .006).” Original side unassigned. Analytic n left null because Table 7 prints neither paired-test n nor df; Table 6 scale sample counts retained as contextual evidence only. The p. 65 prose attributes d = .48 to Conduct Problems versus Oppositional Defiant, whereas rendered Table 7 explicitly assigns d = .48, t = 3.69*, p < .01 to Delinquent and d = .26, t = 2.67, p = .01 to Oppositional Defiant. Values here follow the identified Table 7 row without merging the conflicting prose.
Source follow-up: Primary source is the complete Spring 2020 master’s thesis, repository deposit 4783. Table 6 numeric values were checked against rendered PDF p. 59. Printed d retained without conversion. Exact p column retained; table note gives Bonferroni correction α = .006. Analytic n is contextual from Table 5 scale counts, not independently printed for each Table 6 dependent t-test; n confidence is therefore false. Unassigned replication and original-only success verdict left null.
